description: Negative search result: keyword searches of the City of Edinburgh Council planning record (via PlanIt mirror of citydev-portal.edinburgh.gov.uk) for 'gogar', 'gogarburn' and 'data centre' found no data centre application, PAN or EIA screening at Gogar/Gogarburn itself. The only Edinburgh data centre cases are at Riccarton/Currie (Apatura: 25/03978/PAN, 25/02924/SCR decided EIA Not Required 2025-07-04, 25/05576/SCR decided EIA Not Required 2026-05-06 - see wester-hermiston) and 1 Redheughs Avenue (Shelborn: 25/01968/PAN, 25/03575/SCR EIA not required, 25/04239/PPP refused, appeal PPA-230-2794 - see south-gyle). The reported 'Gogar 200 MW EIA-screened-out data centre' therefore has no distinct planning case; the candidate screening references are 25/03575/SCR and 25/02924/SCR, held on the related project records.
decision_notes: No decision exists because no distinct case exists.
